programme.desc: The world's greatest detective and his loyal sidekick join forces to solve a murder at Buckingham Palace before the Queen becomes the next victim.

programme.desc: Black Hawk Down

programme.title: Step Brothers
programme.desc: Two aimless middle-aged losers still living at home are forced against their will to become roommates when their parents marry.

programme.desc: Two young brothers are drawn into an intergalactic adventure when their house is hurled through the depths of space by the magical board game they are playing.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: A young Peter Parker/Spider-Man begins to navigate his newfound identity as the web-slinging superhero.

programme.title: Black And Blue
programme.desc: A rookie New Orleans police officer is forced to balance her identity as a black woman after she witnesses two corrupt cops committing murder.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Young Blade Runner K's discovery of a long-buried secret leads him to track down former Blade Runner Rick Deckard, who's been missing for thirty years.

programme.title: 28 Days Later
programme.desc: Four weeks after a mysterious, incurable virus spreads throughout the United Kingdom, a handful of survivors try to find sanctuary.

programme.title: The International

programme.title: The Forest (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: An American woman enters Japan's legendary Suicide Forest in search for her twin sister, who has mysteriously disappeared.

programme.title: Blumhouse's Fantasy Island (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: When the owner and operator of a luxurious island invites a collection of guests to live out their most elaborate fantasies in relative seclusion, chaos quickly descends.

programme.title: The Emoji Movie (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Gene, a multi-expressional emoji, sets out on a journey to become a normal emoji.

programme.title: Monster Hunter (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: When Cpt. Artemis and her loyal soldiers are transported to a new world, they engage in a desperate battle for survival against enormous enemies with incredible powers. Feature film based on the video game by Capcom.

programme.title: Among The Shadows
programme.desc: A private investigator must unravel the murder of her uncle while keeping the secret that she is a descendant from a line of werewolves.

programme.title: Bad Men Must Bleed
programme.desc: Follows a man as he hunts his brother's gang across the old west to stop their rampage.

programme.title: Gravy
programme.desc: It's All Hallow's Eve. A trio of costumed misfits with very special dietary requirements seizes a Mexican cantina and force the staff to engage in a late night of gaming, food and libations. The only caveat is what's on the menu.

programme.title: While We Sleep
programme.desc: After observing a hauntingly familiar abnormal CAT scan of a 13 year old girl, radiologist Nina Evanko battles to find the source of the young girl's sleeping disorder. What she discovers is darker and stranger than she could have imagined.

programme.title: Hotel Dunsmuir
programme.desc: A young woman with extrasensory perception flees her abusive husband, only to land at an historic hotel containing a sinister presence.

programme.title: Don't Kill It
programme.desc: An ancient demon terrorizes a tiny Mississippi town.

programme.title: Burial Ground Massacre
programme.desc: A group of college students spend a night at an old, eerie manor, only to realize that a terrifying stalker is watching their every move as he begins plans to repossess an ancient Native American artifact located inside.

programme.title: The Housekeeper
programme.desc: A young housekeeper accepts a promising position at the home of a wealthy family, only to realize that someone may hiding a deadly secret. Not knowing who to trust, she must solve the mystery while avoiding impending deadly consequences.

programme.title: Call Me King
programme.desc: In the international world of gun running loyalty, honor and discretion are valuable commodities, but nothing is more priceless than the bond of family. Power begets enemies and a loved ones betrayal cuts like a knife. Sides will be chosen, wars will be fought. In the end, there can only be one King.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away in a remote country house but when a mysterious man turns up and telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: War Pigs
programme.desc: A ragtag unit of misfits known as the War Pigs must go behind enemy lines to exterminate Nazis by any means necessary.

programme.title: Traded
programme.desc: In the 1880s western "Traded", a father must leave his ranch for Dodge City to save his daughter from an old enemy, putting his reputation as the fastest draw in the west to the test.

programme.title: The Lurking Fear
programme.desc: When a TV crew shoots a reality show at an abandoned mental institution, they encounter a horde of demons, leading to a bloody fight for survival.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: Set during World War 2, a squad of American Army soldiers are sent on a mission behind lines to locate their missing commanding officer.

programme.title: Radioflash
programme.desc: When a nuclear device causes an electromagnetic pulse that kills power to more than 200 million people, a teenage girl must help lead her family to survival in a dark new world.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: In the lawless West, a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves called The Cowboys reigns over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate finally catches up with them.

programme.title: The Retaliators
programme.desc: An upstanding pastor uncovers a dark and twisted underworld as he searches for answers surrounding his daughter's brutal murder.

programme.title: Chosen

programme.title: Damon's Revenge

programme.title: Kill Craft

programme.title: American Rider

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: Ukiyoe Edo-Life
programme.desc: Centuries ago, Tokyo was known as Edo. More than a million people enjoyed life in this small but abundant city. They live on in ukiyo-e woodblock prints. Each episode is a deep dive into a single print, and an exploration of the soul of Old Tokyo. We examine works by artists like Hokusai and Hiroshige not just for their aesthetic and historical value, but for the stories they tell of everyday life. That is how the people of Edo themselves enjoyed this mass-produced medium.

programme.title: Decoding Animal Culture, Ep 1
programme.desc: As humans, animals share knowledge and traditions that they learn from each other and pass on from generation to generation. For the first time, scientists and experts in ecology and ethology agree to point out animal culture as the second form of inheritance beyond genetics. In this three-part series, we take a closer look at fascinating behaviors in the wild only to discover how incredibly widespread culture is in animal populations, identifying the wide range of common skills and preferences binding individuals together. Now is the time to explore animal societies across the planet with a new perspective, unveiling the unexpected abilities and subtleties of a cultural repertoire previously imperceptible to our eyes. Let's take a closer look on how much we have in common with the animal world.

programme.title: Greatest Classics S1, Ep 44
programme.desc: FIGHT SPORTS presents another excitingGreatest Classics episode, bringing you more action featuring the greatest fighters in boxing history. In a fight for the vacant NABF Welterweight Championship, evenly matched Derrell Coley (29-1-2) and Kip Diggs (27-2) square off in what would be a classic back-and-forth battle, with multiple knockdowns and a fight to close to call on the judges' scorecards. In the undercard, a young Fernando Vargas, who would go on to claim a World Championship the following year, makes his professional debut in his hometown of Oxnard, California. It's a stacked card on this episode of Greatest Classics.
